problem_text:
A logistics manager must select packages to load onto a cargo drone. The available packages are:
* Package 1: volume 43 cubic feet, revenue $39
* Package 2: volume 43 cubic feet, revenue $80
* Package 3: volume 38 cubic feet, revenue $296
* Package 4: volume 13 cubic feet, revenue $13
* Package 5: volume 3 cubic feet, revenue $217
* Package 6: volume 36 cubic feet, revenue $261
* Package 7: volume 46 cubic feet, revenue $64
* Package 8: volume 31 cubic feet, revenue $296
* Package 9: volume 23 cubic feet, revenue $185
* Package 10: volume 7 cubic feet, revenue $12
* Package 11: volume 16 cubic feet, revenue $126
* Package 12: volume 32 cubic feet, revenue $169
* Package 13: volume 18 cubic feet, revenue $125
* Package 14: volume 1 cubic feet, revenue $263
* Package 15: volume 23 cubic feet, revenue $270

The drone's cargo hold has a maximum capacity of 261 cubic feet. Choose the set of packages that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this volume limit. Each package must be either fully loaded or left behind.
